evaluation: Historical 5-fold purged out-of-fold scores, November 4 publication-year labels. Not 2026 outcomes.

definitions.percentile_rank: pandas Series.rank(method='average', pct=True); higher is a higher model score
definitions.ensemble_score: mean of the three percentile ranks; matches historical_rankings.csv
definitions.percentile_std: population standard deviation of the three percentile ranks (ddof=0)
definitions.tie_break: better stored ensemble rank, then CVE ID; does not favor the challenger
definitions.label_caveat: A CVE not in KEV by the cutoff is an observed non-positive, not proof of no exploitation.
definitions.causal_caveat: Rank differences are descriptive. They are not explanations of why a model scored a CVE as it did.

ties.note: Percentile ranks use average ties, as in Chen's ensemble. Displayed competition ranks use minimum ties, matching investigation_cases.json, so a CVE in a large tie block shows the best rank of that block. Selection rules use average-tie percentiles, except the dissent gate.

unstratified_tests_confounded_by_rank.note: These compare missed positives with all unconfirmed CVEs outside the top K. Misses sit closer to the cutoff than a typical unconfirmed CVE, so a difference here can be ensemble rank in disguise. The neighbor test is the rank-localized check.

neighbor_test.definition: For each missed positive, compare it with CVEs ranked within 250 places on either side, never crossing back into the original top K. The share is the fraction of those neighbors with a smaller value. A median share of 0.5 means the miss looks ordinary for its ensemble rank.

signal_patterns.epss_v4_assumption: EPSS v4 replaced v3 on 17 March 2025. Snapshot months through 2025-02 are treated as v3. Snapshot month 2025-03 and later are treated as v4 because the monthly file is a month-end view and the cutover was 17 March. Raw EPSS is not compared across this boundary. Within-month percentiles are the EPSS summary used in every pooled comparison.

disagreement_by_signal_state.note: Exploratory, not a pre-specified test. Signal states are mutually exclusive: monthly row absent (flags and EPSS unknown), row present with all four code flags zero, or at least one recorded flag. The dissent pool is CVEs outside the ensemble top K that at least one model ranked inside its own top K. Positive rates are counts against the November 4 label, not exploitation probabilities.

summed.note: Extra slots are split across publish-date blocks in proportion to how many of the block's CVEs sit outside the original global top 517. The original 32 are not recounted. This is a sensitivity, not a new selected model.

exploratory_full_dissent_pool_check.why_post_hoc: Noticed after the pre-specified budgets were scored: the upside-gap ordering placed most pool positives late. Comparing the whole pool with an equal-size ensemble extension was not planned.

notable_observations: After conditioning on ensemble rank, missed positives tend to have a larger upside gap than their neighbors. The watchlist table is the check on whether that shift is large enough to spend review budget on.
At every pre-specified extra budget, ordering by the best individual percentile recovered no more historical positives than continuing in ensemble order.
9 missed positives were inside at least one model's own top 517, alongside 712 unconfirmed CVEs.
Recorded exploit-code flags occur for 9.3% of misses and 2.2% of all historical CVEs.
